Q5738.reason: A hybrid contract is governed by the UCC unless its predominant purpose is the service portion, so Connie wins under the UCC on that test.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires felonious intent at the moment of entry; he entered only to crash the party and decided to steal the baseball only after he was inside.

Q8324.reason: Extreme agitation, aggression, and coercive demands fit excess dopamine activity, which here is seizure-like firing in dopamine regions rather than a dopamine deficit or cell loss.
